newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Antenna Hungaria boosts capital by HUF 2.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Antenna Hungaria boosts capital by HUF 2.5 bln.

text.p: Hungary's national broadcaster Antenna Hungaria Rt (AH) increased its registered capital by 2.5 billion forints ($14.7 million) to 10.3 billion forints on Friday, in preparation for media privatisation, the Hungarian news agency MTI said.
The government said last week that the 2.5 billion forints would come from privatisation agency APV Rt and would be spent on funding development projects in 1997.

Hungary has offered ten-year concessions for two national Television and two radio channels and state-owned AH, which broadcasts all of Hungary's radio and TV programmes has to upgrade the infrastructure.

AH needs to develop the infrastructure for broadcasting of a national TV-channel, two national FM-channels and to build a sattelite uplink for state television's Channel 2, which will go on satellite once its frequency has been taken over by private television.
The broadcasting infrastructure develgpments call for total investments of four billion forints. The government is expected to decide this year how to provide the remaining 1.5 billion.
The government has not yet decided on AH's privatisation strategy, which analysts believe will only happen once the radio and TV- channels have been privatised.
